text: Range defect: no check enforces SubMainGridRatio>0 before NumPixel is formed at L104, dimensions are allocated at L106-L109, and division by REAL(NumPixel) occurs at L171-L172 and L213-L214. Zero or negative input can therefore create invalid/zero extents and division by zero.

Both the initial equal-time state and EOF collapse interpolation weights to zero: TIME_COUPLING_2 is initialized equal to TIME_COUPLING_1 (L93-L95), while equal slots set tmp1=tmp2=ZERO (L488-L497). At EOF, TIME_COUPLING_1 is first advanced to TIME_COUPLING_2, the failed read jumps to L483 (L367-L372), and the same equal-slot branch zeros every coupled ETA/U/V ghost value at L509-L588 instead of retaining the last boundary record.

L8 constructs nine weights of 0.11111, whose sum is 0.99999 rather than 1; L9 applies that non-unit-sum kernel and L11 installs its result, so even a spatially constant interior is attenuated slightly on each script run.

The periodic WK_REG initialization computes 2*pi/Tperiod before testing Tperiod==ZERO (L83-L91). The same ineffective ordering recurs in WK_WAVEMAKER_2D_SPECTRAL_DATA (Tperiod=1/Freq at L783, test at L788), WK_WAVEMAKER_REGULAR_WAVE (division L2381, test L2385), WK_WAVEMAKER_TIME_SERIES (division L2435, test L2441), and WK_NEW_WAVEMAKER_2D_SPECTRAL_DATA (division L2760, test L2766); zero frequency/period can fault before the intended guard.

WK_DATA2D compresses retained directions and WAVE_COMP into DireTmp/WaveCompTmp (L238-L275) but never applies the same index map to Phase2D read at L213-L215. When phases are present, L295-L301 converts the first NumDir original phase columns, which need not correspond to the retained directions after rejected columns; amplitude and phase can therefore be paired from different directions.

WK_WAVEMAKER_2D_SPECTRAL_DATA returns Beta_gen(NumFreq,NumDir) (L638), and initialization passes Beta_gen2D to CALCULATE_Cm_Sm (L328-L332), but CALCULATE_Cm_Sm declares beta_gen(mfreq) (L842) and indexes only beta_gen(kf) in the direction loop (L858-L880). This is a rank/interface mismatch and discards direction-dependent beta values.
All equal-frequency variants divide by mfreq-1 without an mfreq>1 guard (L1584, L2160, L2849). A one-component configuration therefore produces a singular df before later loops.

WK_NEW_EQUAL_DFREQ_IRREGULAR_WAVE initializes only theta(1) and AG(1) when mtheta==1 (L2860-L2862), although both arrays have length mfreq (L2832-L2834). It later evaluates dot_product over all AG entries (L2914), reads AG(kf) for every component (L2917-L2919), and reads theta(kf) in the component loop (L2940, L3015-L3019), so entries 2:mfreq are used before assignment.

phi1 in WK_NEW_EQUAL_DFREQ_IRREGULAR_WAVE is INTENT(OUT) (L2836) but random phases are assigned only inside IF(PERIODIC) at L2941-L3014. The nonperiodic return leaves phi1 undefined, yet WAVEMAKER_INITIALIZATION immediately passes it to CALCULATE_NEW_Cm_Sm (L590-L599), whose trigonometric fields read phi1 at L3105-L3117 and L3128-L3162.

interpolatedVectors is allocated with shape [nx_total,n_vectors_cyclic] at L317 and each column is one x-profile (L320-L322), but L326 and L330 assign an nx_total-by-1 column directly into a 1-by-nx_total row slice of zb_domain. MATLAB does not make these orientations conformable for matrix subscript assignment; the cyclic path needs an explicit transpose or a row-oriented temporary.

L459 already applies resize to imag; L463-L464 then measure that resized image, but L477-L478 multiply those measured dimensions by resize again before L485 resamples to the uniform grid. For resize values other than 1, the returned/plotted grid therefore applies the requested dimension factor twice (for example resize=2 produces another twofold output dimension after imresize).

Cohesive deposition probability is not bounded below: Pd becomes negative when Tau_xy exceeds Tau_crd_coh (L1363), and D is then assigned WS*CH*Pd without MAX(0,...) (L1364). Because the transport source is Pickup-D (L1208), negative deposition acts as an additional positive concentration source.

Avalanche transfers are stored with scalar assignment rather than accumulation: each steep cell writes both its own and one neighbor's Zb_avalanching entry (L1585-L1627). Later loop iterations can overwrite earlier incoming/outgoing transfers to the same cell before the one-shot bed update at L1633-L1634, making the result loop-order dependent and losing superposed transfers.

DXg and DYg are assigned only in the nested non-VIS_DEPTH_RATIO path at L160-L167 when the L151 onset condition is false and the L154 age condition reaches its ELSE, but they are used unconditionally for xmk/ymk at L238-L243; onset cells and already-aging cells therefore use unassigned coordinate spacings.
L13 indexes dep(1:100,1:72) without checking the dimensions of data returned at L8; a TIFF with fewer than 100 rows or 72 columns causes an out-of-range indexing failure.

K at L25 uses nine coefficients of 0.11111, whose sum is 0.99999 rather than exactly 1; the interior replacement at L28 therefore slightly attenuates a constant field on every application instead of preserving it exactly.

초기화 누락/조건 불일치: ALLOCATE_VARIABLES는 CARTESIAN/ZALPHA에서 U4xL/U4xR, V4yL/V4yR뿐 아니라 V4xL/V4xR와 U4yL/U4yR도 할당하지만(L143-L161), INITIALIZATION의 영 초기화는 CARTESIAN U4xL/U4xR와 V4yL/V4yR 네 배열만 다룬다(L473-L478). V4xL/V4xR·U4yL/U4yR은 이 파일에서 초기화되지 않으며 ZALPHA 빌드에서는 앞의 네 배열도 영 초기화되지 않는다.
도달불가 설정: non-CARTESIAN 분기에서 SLOPE_CTR를 L1172에서 항상 .FALSE.로 덮은 직후 L1174와 L1183-L1186에서 IF(SLOPE_CTR) 보호 코드를 둔다. 이 루틴 실행에서는 경고와 slope cap이 모두 도달 불가이며 외부 입력으로 활성화할 경로가 보이지 않는다.

use-before-assign 가능성: CONSTRUCTION에서 U4xL/U4xR은 DISPERSION일 때만 L459-L465에서 구성되지만 CARTESIAN PL/PR와 FxL/FxR은 L474-L509에서 이를 무조건 참조한다. 같은 패턴으로 V4yL/V4yR은 L569-L575 조건부 정의 뒤 L581-L636에서 참조된다. DISPERSION=false에서 전역 배열의 별도 초기화가 없다면 미정의 값을 읽는다.

CALCULATE_SPONGE_MAKER는 Iwidth를 INT(width/DX)+Nghost로 정한 뒤(L190-L192) Iwidth-1로 나눈다(L204/L207). CALCULATE_SPONGE도 각 양의 경계 폭에서 같은 분모를 사용한다(L636-L653, L664-L681, L703-L720, L732-L749). 이 파일에는 Iwidth>1 검사가 없어 Nghost와 폭/간격 조합이 Iwidth<=1이면 0 나눗셈 또는 비정상 지수가 발생한다.

비분산 실행에서 고차 보정 배열의 정의-사용 순서가 닫히지 않는다. 예를 들어 CONSTRUCTION_HO_minmod는 U4xL/V4xL을 DISPERSION일 때만 L850-L855에서 정의하지만 L860-L924에서 조건 없이 읽고, y 배열도 L948-L953에서만 정의한 뒤 L955-L1020에서 읽는다. 같은 구조가 CONSTRUCTION(L590-L604 대 L609-L664), CONSTRUCTION_HO(L1352-L1357 대 L1359-L1420; L1444-L1449 대 L1451-L1513), MLP(L1785-L1790 대 L1792-L1853; L1873-L1878 대 L1880-L1942), WENO(L2145-L2148 대 L2150-L2207; L2220-L2223 대 L2225-L2283)에 반복된다. Gamma1이 0이어도 미정의/NaN 배열과의 곱은 안전하지 않으므로 외부 초기화 보장이 없다면 use-before-assign이다.
L744-790: U_FILE 누락 시 NO_UV_FILE=.TRUE.로 만들지만 V_FILE이 존재하면 후속 ELSE가 이를 .FALSE.로 덮어쓴 뒤 곧바로 IF(NO_UV_FILE)로 복구를 시도하므로, U만 누락된 경우를 보존하지 못하는 교차라인 상태 결함이다.
L2707 대 L3028-3031: ROLLER가 READ_INPUT 후반에서 읽히기 약 320행 전에 IF(ROLLER)로 VISCOSITY_BREAKING을 강제한다. 이 파일 안에서는 선행 대입이 없어 use-before-assign이며, 입력 ROLLER_EFFECT는 이 선행 결정에 반영될 수 없다.

Use-before-assign on missing NumVessel: READ_INTEGER at L149 has no ierr/default branch, but NumVessel is immediately used as every allocation extent at L263-L285 and as the loop bound at L312. A missing or invalid key leaves the module integer without a defined value before allocation.

Source/propeller interface mismatch: propeller inputs are read only inside the PR source branch at L352-L360, but E0, Veff, Cf, and IZEF are computed unconditionally for every vessel under PROPELLER at L445-L450. SL or PA vessels therefore use unassigned N_revolution, D_prop, C_thrust, D_hub, BAR, H_prop, and C_duct.

PA initialization mismatch: geometry/source parameters are read for PR at L352-L381 and SL at L383-L388, with no PA branch before the path read at L389-L390; VESSEL_FORCING nevertheless dispatches PA to GREEN_FUNCTION_SOURCE at L552-L555, which uses LengthVessel, WidthVessel, Pvessel and related state at L827-L875. Those values are unassigned for PA as parsed here.

L541-L600: Holland_Model_Forcing가 새 레코드를 읽기 전에 TimeStorm1/Xstorm1/Ystorm1만 이전 2값으로 이동시키고 Pn_storm1/Pc_storm1/A_storm1/B_storm1은 갱신하지 않는다. L596-L601 보간은 두 번째 구간부터 새 endpoint와 최초 레코드의 압력·형상 계수를 섞어 잘못된 storm 강도를 만든다.
L1076-L1120: MeteoGausian_Forcing도 rollover 때 Time/X/Y만 갱신하고 DP_storm1/SigmaX1/SigmaY1/Theta1을 이전 2값으로 옮기지 않는다. 두 번째 구간부터 Gaussian 크기·폭·방향 보간의 왼쪽 endpoint가 낡는다.
L165-L188,L247-L297: 초기화는 첫 raster를 PrecRateData2에만 읽고 PrecRateData1을 초기화하지 않는다. 다음 timestamp를 넘기기 전에는 tmp1/tmp2가 둘 다 ZERO이므로 L294에서 첫 rainfall field가 0으로 사라지며, 첫 갱신 전 입력 강수가 적용되지 않는다.

MPI use-before-assignment defect: X_TRACK_ALL, Y_TRACK_ALL, and IN_CELL_ALL are populated only inside myid==0 blocks at L442-L466, but the selection loop at L470-L477 is outside any root guard and reads these automatic local arrays on every rank. Non-root ranks therefore branch on and copy uninitialized gathered arrays before the later scatter overwrites coordinates.

Range/singularity exposure: Iwidth comes from unvalidated WaveMakerPointNum (L117-L120), appears in denominators Iwidth-1 at L261-L300, and controls array loop bounds at L325-L360. Iwidth=1 makes the exponent division singular; Iwidth greater than Mloc or Nloc produces out-of-range or non-domain boundary indices.
